title: SnipReply - canned email templates for support teams
description: Chrome extension + small Flask backend that lets support agents insert canned replies in Gmail. 480 installs, 62 paying at $3/mo. Founder moved on to a new job and has not touched it in 6 months. Clean codebase, Stripe billing already wired up.
tech_stack: Python, Flask, JavaScript, Chrome Extension, Stripe

title: PocketOKR - lightweight OKR tracker for tiny teams
description: Rails-free! A C# / ASP.NET Minimal API + vanilla JS OKR tracker. 1,100 free users, 14 teams on the $9/mo plan. Organic SEO traffic from 'simple okr tool' keywords. Roughly 2 hrs/wk of support email. Selling because owner is consolidating products.

title: FeedStitch - merge RSS feeds into one clean digest
description: Rust (Axum) service that merges multiple RSS/Atom feeds and emails a daily digest. Pre-revenue but 2,300 registered users and 9k monthly visits from a single viral HN post. Costs $6/mo to run on a VPS. Seller wants a quick no-earn-out exit.
